MoneySurfer is a personal and household budgeting tool provided to you as-is, without warranties of any kind. By using the app you agree to these terms.

You are responsible for the accuracy of every account, transaction, and budget you enter. MoneySurfer does not verify your data and is not a substitute for professional financial, tax, or legal advice.

The app is intended for lawful personal use only. You may not use it to store unlawful content or to infringe the rights of others.

MoneySurfer is provided free of charge and may change or stop working at any time. We are not liable for any loss arising from using, or being unable to use, the app, including loss of data stored on your device.

These terms may be updated in future releases. Continuing to use the app after an update means you accept the revised terms.

MoneySurfer is built offline-first. In offline mode — when you use the app without an account — all of your budgeting data is stored on your device and nothing is transmitted to our servers.

Your accounts, transactions, budgets, and settings then live solely in the app's local storage. We do not sell this data or share it with third parties.

If you sign in to enable cloud sync, your synced data is sent to our hosting provider so it can be shared across your own devices and household. Sync is optional; without an account, your budgeting data never leaves the device.

The app may collect anonymous crash reports and diagnostics to help us fix problems. It contains no advertising.

Uninstalling the app, or clearing its data, permanently removes everything stored on your device.
